name: vesper-monorepo
description: Vesper: a git-based CMS for Astro sites.
//engines: Astro 7.4 needs Node 22.22+. Node 22.18+ also strips TypeScript types by default, which the @vesper/source dev loop relies on.

scripts.//dev: The playground in astro dev. Workspace packages load from source, so there is nothing to prebuild.
scripts.//build: Emits dist/ for every package. Only publishing and check:dist read it; dev and tests run from source.
scripts.//check:dist: Imports every published entry point from dist/ with the source condition off.
scripts.//typecheck: Package build configs through project references, then each package tsconfig (which includes tests), the e2e specs, and root tool configs.
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p e2e && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.//e2e: Playwright + axe against the built playground on a no-rewrite static server (the spec §6.16 plain host). Build the playground first.
scripts.//lint: ESLint over the whole repo, including the package-boundary rules for @vesper/core.
scripts.//format: Prettier formats code and config only; prose and content files are ignored on purpose (.prettierignore).
scripts.//a11y:contrast: Parses packages/ui/src/tokens.css and checks every colour pair against WCAG 2.1 in both themes, plus the spec §10.4 token budget.
scripts.//changeset: Record a release note and version bump for changed @vesper/* packages (see .changeset/README.md).
